title: The turn model is decided in two places (Lambda code and the owner image) and can drift
description: 2026-10-11: after the switch to gpt-6-luna the Lambda turns used luna while the owner container, whose bundle bakes DEFAULT_TURN_MODEL into the image, stayed on gpt-5-nano until the image was rebuilt and pushed by hand. A turn that starts on the Lambda and hands over to the owner could change model mid-turn after any model change. Decide the model once (the Lambda that starts the turn) and pass it to the owner in the takeover (start job env, like the owner id), so the owner never reads its own copy. Scenario: the owner uses the model named in its takeover input. Also consider the image pipeline (an image build in CI so a code change cannot leave a stale image).
right_now_summary: The team is aligning turn model selection in the Lambda and owner handoff to prevent model drift.
